observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly on a tiled floor.
The lens has visible surface scratches and reflections; no large cracks are obvious in the visible area.
The right side has an amber indicator section.
The rear housing shows plastic mounting brackets and a wiring connector opening.
A watermark "PUREGOLD GLOBAL" is stamped across the lens.
No part number, Toyota logo, or model marking is legible on the part.
The seller sent only text, claiming to have tested it yesterday; no new photo or clip was provided.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy.
claims.evidence: No Toyota logo or part number is readable in photo 0; seller's text alone is not proof.
Only the visible lens surface is shown in photo 0; hairline cracks cannot be ruled out.
Some rear mounts are visible in photo 0, but not all can be confirmed intact.

claims.claim: All kia and Hyundai genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used
claims.evidence: Seller's general inventory claim cannot be checked from one part photo.

claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: Seller's statement only; no photo or video of the test was sent.

risks.risk: Part is aftermarket or a copy, not genuine Toyota.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any embossed brand, part number, or Toyota marking on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-genuine aftermarket headlight.

risks.risk: Lens has hairline cracks or internal damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Video or photos of the lens from multiple angles in direct light.

risks.risk: Mounting clips or brackets are broken or missing.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the back and side mounting points from all angles.

risks.risk: Electrical components or bulbs do not work.
risks.proof: Video of the headlight illuminated with power connected.

risks.risk: Part may not fit the buyer's specific car model.
risks.proof: Part number or list of compatible vehicle models.

proof_requests: Close-up of any branding or part number on the headlight housing.
Photos of the lens from multiple angles to check for cracks.
Photos of all rear mounting clips and brackets.
Part number and compatible car models.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a car headlight assembly by type, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's verbal claim adds no verifiable evidence.
